title: Allow bank rec. duplicated transactions surfaced in UI
summary: Bank reconciliation now exposes UI controls to allow users to process duplicate transactions when importing bank statements, addressing scenarios with SEPA CAMT files containing duplicate transaction IDs.
key_points: Resurfaces existing functionality for handling duplicate transactions during bank statement imports
Adds UI controls to bank reconciliation and payment reconciliation journal pages
Addresses SEPA CAMT import scenarios where duplicate transaction IDs are valid
Improves caption precision for reconciliation options
Resolves issue discovered with German customer SEPA imports
quote: This change resurfaces this functionality, to give this option to users that need it.
